prompt: Edit image 1 and change only the table surface: add one long roll of white paper unrolled flat down the centre of the long wooden table, a straight band of paper about a third as wide as the table, running from the near end of the table at the bottom of the frame straight toward the far doorway and stopping in a clean straight cut edge level with the crayon boy's chair and the braids girl's chair, the second pair of seats from the camera; beyond that cut edge the whole far half of the table, past the crayon boy and the braids girl all the way to the far end, stays bare wood exactly as in image 1, with no paper on it. On the roll are many rows of small children's crayon family drawings in soft pastel colours, each row three to five simple figures holding hands: moms with brown hair, dads in big shoes, children and a grandma with a purple purse, every figure upright with its head toward the far doorway; there is no robot, no machine and no writing on any drawing. The roll is flat, not rolled up. Keep the room, the light and its stripes, the camera, the table, the chairs, the crayon bucket, the three children's own small white sheets at their seats and MACA standing in the far doorway exactly as they are. Maria in the nearest seat on the left side still sits very still with her small rolled-up white drawing held upright in her lap, looking down at it: that small tube is separate from the long roll on the table. The crayon boy beside her still draws with a green crayon, the braids girl and the jersey boy across the table still draw. Exactly four children and MACA; nobody else in the room. Image 1 is the authority for render style, lens, lighting, room, furniture and colour: keep its finished 3D animated film look exactly, as if this were another frame of the same shot. Image 2 is the identity board. The identity board is a painted character sheet used only for identity (faces, hair, wardrobe colours); never copy its painted style, its plain background or its poses. Identity, from the identity board: Maria is a small girl with black bangs, a thin yellow headband, a side ponytail with a pink scrunchie, a pink overall outfit over a light-blue collared shirt and purple boots. The crayon boy has tousled ginger-blond hair and a green T-shirt with a small dinosaur. The braids girl has two dark braids and olive overalls over a cream shirt. The jersey boy has short brown hair and a white shirt with navy trim. MACA is a tall female robot with a white riveted helmet, a glowing blue face screen with two smiling eyes, a pink chest plate with a small dark inset screen and an orange hip plate. One instance of each character only. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame, 1280x720, no text, no sketch lines.
